subject: TARGET CLAIM: close-cycle-bound cover-route reassert single-flight
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-performance-rd-cover-route-reassert-lifecycle-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. CLAIMED_BOUNDARY=Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.ensureCoverRouteHeld admission and completion lifecycle: determine whether the process-global coverRouteReassertInFlight boolean can suppress a new close cycle after reversal/re-close while an older ensure-held binder call remains in flight, quantify the retry delay, and define a cycle/generation-bound single-flight contract with deterministic tests. Explicit exclusions: semantic device-state re-close cancellation, hinge-ingress coalescing, shell V3 exact-token/CAS lease authority, app-process recovery, presentation/native handoff, semantic content freshness, angle authority, and production GitHub writes. The shell exact-token check is treated as a safety invariant; this work concerns app-side liveness/latency and stale operation bookkeeping only. Cheapest decisive test is a reduced operation scheduler matching current boolean behavior versus keyed request identity across cycle invalidation/re-close.
